description:
Error-rate curves come from configured simulation campaigns. Researchers need the steps to configure, run, checkpoint and resume one.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/how-to/` shows how to configure a campaign file, run it with the campaign binaries, checkpoint and resume it, and locate its output dataset, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from campaign configurations under `dev/campaigns/` and the gf2-sim binaries are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the simulation campaign how-to
